challengeResponse.challengerAppearanceSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="metalGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#999;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#ccc;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#999;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="blueGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1a2a40;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0d1626;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Left Track -->
  <rect x="80" y="100" width="60" height="312" rx="10" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="90" y="110" width="40" height="292" rx="5" fill="#555" />
  <rect x="95" y="120" width="30" height="272" rx="2" fill="#222" />

  <!-- Right Track -->
  <rect x="372" y="100" width="60" height="312" rx="10" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="382" y="110" width="40" height="292" rx="5" fill="#555" />
  <rect x="387" y="120" width="30" height="272" rx="2" fill="#222" />

  <!-- Body -->
  <rect x="140" y="140" width="232" height="232" rx="20" fill="url(#blueGrad)" stroke="#1a2a40" stroke-width="4" />
  
  <!-- Side Red Stripes (Wear and Tear simulated by rects) -->
  <rect x="140" y="160" width="10" height="192" fill="#b31a1a" />
  <rect x="362" y="160" width="10" height="192" fill="#b31a1a" />
  
  <!-- Front Shield Armor (Circular Concentric) -->
  <circle cx="256" cy="140" r="60" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="188 188" transform="rotate(-90 256 140)" />
  <circle cx="256" cy="140" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#b31a1a" stroke-width="6" />
  <circle cx="256" cy="140" r="30" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- Turret Base -->
  <rect x="186" y="180" width="140" height="150" rx="15" fill="#1e3250" stroke="#0e1b2e" stroke-width="4" />
  
  <!-- Turret Star -->
  <path d="M256 210 L265 238 L295 238 L271 256 L280 284 L256 266 L232 284 L241 256 L217 238 L247 238 Z" fill="#fff" />
  
  <!-- Cannon -->
  <rect x="246" y="80" width="20" height="120" rx="5" fill="#ccc" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2" />
  <rect x="248" y="70" width="16" height="20" rx="2" fill="#888" />
  
  <!-- Metal Highlights/Details -->
  <rect x="140" y="100" width="20" height="312" rx="5" fill="url(#metalGrad)" />
  <rect x="352" y="100" width="20" height="312" rx="5" fill="url(#metalGrad)" />
  <rect x="200" y="190" width="112" height="10" rx="2" fill="#2a4566" />
  <rect x="200" y="310" width="112" height="10" rx="2" fill="#2a4566" />
</svg>
